description: The latest quarter, condensed from the MD&A of the most recent quarterly report (10-Q, or 6-K for a foreign issuer): results for the three months and year to date, what changed against the prior year, segment trends, liquidity, capital returns, guidance and any new developments since the annual report. Returns the section's full text as markdown. Headings differ by company and carry the fiscal period, so the section is found by pattern; if this company's narrative has none, the response says so and lists its sections. Pass `record` for the narrative as of an earlier record.

record.description: An earlier published record, by tag ('FY27Q1') or by the period its filing reports ('Q1 FY2027'). Omit for the latest. list_periods lists every record.

ticker.description: Ticker symbol, case-insensitive. Examples: NVDA, brk-b, BRK.B.

name: get_current_quarter
title: Current quarter (quarterly MD&A)
